issues.description: Method parameter label mismatch for Course.addRating(_:): The problem statement (and the template) require an instance method named Course.addRating with external parameter label 'stars' (addRating(stars: Int)). The solution implementation defines the method as func addRating(rating: Int) while the solution's Client calls addRating(stars: ...). This inconsistent parameter name/label will cause a call-site / definition mismatch and likely result in a compilation error or confusion when students try to run the provided solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the parameter label across all artifacts. Preferred fix: change the solution implementation signature to use the 'stars' label to match the problem and template, e.g. 'extension Course { func addRating(stars: Int) { ... } }' and update the implementation body accordingly. Alternatively, change all call sites to use the 'rating' label, but aligning to 'stars' preserves the exercise wording.

issues.description: Concept: the Course instance method that appends a rating. Problem statement and the template extension declare the method as addRating(stars: Int) (parameter label 'stars'). In the solution implementation the method is declared as func addRating(rating: Int) (parameter label 'rating'), while the solution's Client calls swiftCourse.addRating(stars: 4). Because the solution's implementation and the call sites use different external parameter labels ('rating' vs 'stars'), the API is inconsistent with the exercise description and will not compile as-is; students cannot reliably map the required method signature to the provided solution code or call sites.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the parameter label consistent across artifacts. Update the solution implementation to match the problem and template by changing the function signature in solution_repository/Sources/DeveloperLib/Course.swift from `func addRating(rating: Int)` to `func addRating(stars: Int)` and use `stars` inside the method body (e.g. `if stars >= 1 && stars <= 5 { ratings.append(stars) }`). This aligns the implementation with the Client calls (`addRating(stars: ...)`) and the exercise description.
